Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

Plunging Attack

abilities.name: Stellar Restoration
_curatorNotes: First cast (stage 0 of the E→recast chain). gcsim explicitly sets skillFrames[ActionSkill] = 35. Sets the 7.5s skill CD and opens the Lightning Stiletto window (gcsim Status.Add(stilettoKey, 5*60+20) = 320f = 5.33s). Authored as chainStage index 0 with window 5.33 — a second E within the window resolves to the recast (keqing__skill__stellar_restoration_recast), mirroring Diluc's E1/E2/E3 chainStage pattern. After the window the chain resets and E is a fresh first cast (still gated by the 7.5s CD). Previously the recast was an unreachable input-less variant on this ability; converted 2026-07-15.
Hold (first cast): gcsim uses identical skillFrames for tap and hold first cast — hold only changes throw direction, not animation timing; no separate hold frames authored.
Charged-Attack consumption of the Stiletto (the alternate to the E recast) is a normal-side mechanic, not modeled here.
abilities.description:
Hurls a Lightning Stiletto that annihilates her opponents like the swift thunder.
When the Stiletto hits its target, it deals Electro DMG to opponents in a small AoE, and places a Stiletto Mark on the spot hit.

Hold
Hold to adjust the direction in which the Stiletto shall be thrown.
Stilettos thrown by the Hold attack mode can be suspended in mid-air, allowing Keqing to jump to them when using Stellar Restoration a second time.

Lightning Stiletto
 If Keqing uses Stellar Restoration again or uses a Charged Attack while its duration lasts, it will clear the Stiletto Mark and produce different effects:
·If she uses Stellar Restoration again, she will blink to the location of the Mark and unleash one slashing attack that deals AoE Electro DMG. When blinking to a Stiletto that was thrown from a Holding attack, Keqing can leap across obstructing terrain.
·If Keqing uses a Charged Attack, she will ignite a series of thundering cuts at the Mark's location, dealing AoE Electro DMG.

abilities.name: Stellar Restoration (Blink)
_curatorNotes: Second cast (stage 1, terminal) of the E→recast chain: Keqing blinks to the Lightning Stiletto and slashes (AoE Electro). gcsim skillRecast() — routed by the ActionReady override while stilettoKey is active. Does NOT set a skill CD (cooldown 0); the first cast's independent 7.5s CD keeps running. Frames = skillRecastFrames (hitmark 16). Terminal chainStage (no window) → the chain resets to stage 0 afterward, so the next E is a fresh first cast. Converted 2026-07-15 from the old unreachable input-less 'E Recast (Blink)' variant so a second E token actually renders the blink (Diluc E1/E2/E3 precedent).

C1 Thundering Might (2 particles on recast) and the C1 +50% ATK recast hit are semantically tied to THIS ability; both remain authored on the C1 constellation with manual/placeholder triggers — a future pass could gate them on chainStage index 1.
abilities.description: Using Stellar Restoration again while the Lightning Stiletto persists: Keqing blinks to the Mark's location and unleashes a slashing attack that deals AoE Electro DMG. Blinking to a Stiletto thrown from a Hold cast lets her leap across obstructing terrain.

abilities.name: Starward Sword
abilities.description:
Keqing unleashes the power of lightning, dealing Electro DMG in an AOE.
She then blends into the shadow of her blade, striking a series of thunderclap-blows to nearby opponents simultaneously that deal multiple instances of Electro DMG. The final attack deals massive AoE Electro DMG.

_curatorNotes: Effect not yet authored. A1: on E recast (skillRecast in skill.go calls a1()), grants Electro infusion for ~5.33s (5*60+20 = 320 frames per asc.go). Applies to normal, charged, and plunge attacks per gcsim AddWeaponInfuse call. Likely `onCast` with skill ability condition; ascension ≥1 gated.

A4 second effect (ER +15%) not yet authored — no `energyRecharge` stat key exists in the Stat type. Add when the schema gains an ER stat.
passives.description: When casting Starward Sword, Keqing's CRIT Rate is increased by 15%, and her Energy Recharge is increased by 15%. This effect lasts for 8s.

constellations.name: Thundering Might
_curatorNotes: Existing damage effect: inherited `manual` trigger. Likely `onCast` with skill recast condition; gcsim fires 2 hits in skillRecast() — one at frame 3 (start point, CircleHitOnTarget at caster) and one at frame 16/skillRecastHitmark (terminus, CircleHit toward target). Multiplier 0.5 = 50% ATK confirmed from gcsim Mult field. Reviewer to decide trigger representation for the dual hit positions.
constellations.description: Recasting Stellar Restoration while a Lightning Stiletto is present causes Keqing to deal 50% of her ATK as AoE Electro DMG at the start point and terminus of her Blink.

constellations.name: Keen Extraction
_curatorNotes: Partial fit for `enemyAffectedBy` primitive (E2 follow-up, 2026-05-10). Effect would be `onHit` (N/CA only) + `enemyAffectedBy: electro` + 5s procCooldown + energy effect. Defer authoring: the 50%-chance gate is not expressible in the schema (no probabilistic-trigger primitive), and authoring without it would make the buff over-render at 100% rate vs the in-game 50%. gcsim c2ICDKey + makeC2CB() in cons.go for full mechanic.
constellations.description:
When Keqing's Normal and Charged Attacks hit opponents affected by Electro, they have a 50% chance of producing an Elemental Particle.
This effect can only occur once every 5s.

constellations.name: Foreseen Reformation
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Starward Sword by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Attunement
_curatorNotes: Effect not yet authored. C4: ATK +25% for 10s after Keqing triggers an Electro reaction. Likely `onReaction`. Reaction types from gcsim cons.go c4(): Overload, ElectroCharged, LunarCharged, Superconduct, SwirlElectro, CrystallizeElectro, Quicken, Aggravate, Hyperbloom. Reaction list needs KQM verification — game text uses vague phrasing. Target scope: self. Multiplier 0.25 = 25% ATK confirmed from gcsim c4buff[attributes.ATKP] = 0.25.
constellations.description: For 10s after Keqing triggers an Electro-related Elemental Reaction, her ATK is increased by 25%.

constellations.name: Tenacious Star
_curatorNotes: Existing electroDmgBonus effect: inherited `manual` trigger. Fires on cast of N, CA, E, or Q — gcsim calls c6() from attack.go, charge.go, skill.go, and burst.go respectively. Effects from different ability types are independent entities (up to 4 concurrent stacks, each with own 8s timer per gcsim modifier key 'keqing-c6-'+src). Reviewer to decide stack modeling — consider `stacks: { maxStacks: 4, durationModel: "separate" }`.
constellations.description:
When initiating a Normal Attack, a Charged Attack, Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst, Keqing gains a 6% Electro DMG Bonus for 8s.
Effects triggered by Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, Elemental Skills and Elemental Bursts are considered independent entities.
